# C5 — Static-stability model

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | **UNRESOLVED** — An open question, conflict, or missing measurement blocks a stronger statement. |
| Strongest accepted evidence | MODEL ONLY |
| Evidence classes cited | SPECIFICATION, IMPLEMENTATION, TEST PROCEDURE, ANALYTICAL, SIMULATED |
| Gate reached | SOFTWARE REPRODUCTION (next: SYNTHETIC TEST) |
| Last review | CURRENT — snapshot recorded 2026-09-28 by tooling snapshot (no human review) |

**Question.** Does the modeled rocket keep a static margin of 1.5-2.0 calibers through the motor burn?

**Current statement.** The reference Barrowman script reports 1.55-1.57 cal during a hard-coded Estes C6-5 burn. An unreviewed textbook re-derivation of the fin terms, sharing every other input, gives 0.74-0.76 cal. The two disagree about the 1.5-2.0 cal window, and the script's motor differs from the OpenRocket model's AeroTech G64W.

## Open questions

- Which motor should the CG history use (D-007)?

## Discrepancies

- [D-006](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-006) (OPEN) Reference and textbook fin-term formulations disagree about the static-margin window
- [D-007](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-007) (OPEN) The static-margin script burns a different motor than the OpenRocket model
- [D-008](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-008) (OPEN) Static-margin inputs omit or misread parts of the OpenRocket model
- [D-009](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-009) (OPEN) Model inputs were revised until paper targets were met
- [D-023](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-023) (OPEN) OpenRocket screenshots have no recorded model revision

## Assumptions

- The OpenRocket file's geometry and override masses describe the intended rocket.
- A Barrowman static margin is the quantity the 1.5-2.0 cal target refers to.

## Limitations

- A static margin does not establish dynamic stability or flight readiness.
- The fin geometry was revised to meet the target; matching a target is not validation (D-009).
- Neither model has been independently reviewed.

## Measurement needed to close the next gate

- Independent review of the Barrowman formulation and inputs.
- An inert balance-point measurement of the assembled airframe's dry CG (compare to PRED-C5-DRY-CG).

## Pre-registered experiments

- None.

## What this claim does not establish

- Any inert physical measurement: none has been accepted for this claim.
- Physical performance of any hardware.
- Flight readiness or safety for live propulsion.
